Observed at +11.55972671508789s — page 7
.\n- [Get a study](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-study.md): One study's full read: execution settings (model
, system prompt, tool-approval policy, attached servers, share link), the environment it publishes, and the insights envelope over
its latest analyzed window.\n- [Update a scenario](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/update-a-scenario.md): Change a
study's identity or its exposure, but not both in one call. **Send `mode` on its own.** Identity and exposure are separate operati
ons upstream, and applying them in sequence could leave the study live in a mode you did not ask for.\n- [List a scenario's sessio
ns](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-scenarios-sessions.md): What visitors did, as summaries. Project members
only: this route is deliberately absent from the guest allowlist, so a share-link visitor can never read other visitors' sessions.
\n- [Get a session transcript](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-session-transcript.md): The projected transcrip
t, paged. Tool payloads and blobs are dropped, and the stored blob URL is never returned.\n- [Set the guest-execution caps](https:
//docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/set-the-guest-execution-caps.md): The spend dial for anonymous visitors. A FULL REPLACEMEN
T. Send every field. These caps only mean something as a set, and a partial update that raised one while leaving another stale wou
ld produce a combination nobody chose.\n- [Rotate the share link](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/rotate-the-share-l
ink.md): Mints a new share link and stops the old URL from granting access. Everyone you shared it with needs the new one.\n- [Inv
ite a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/invite-a-member.md): Upsert by email, so re-inviting somebody is not a
n error. Only meaningful while `mode` is `invited_only`.\n- [Remove a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/remove
-a-member.md): Removal NARROWS access, so it bumps `accessVersion` and cuts off any session that member already had: it takes effe
ct at once rather than at expiry.\n- [Point a scenario at a different environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/p
oint-a-scenario-at-a-different-environment.md): Keeps the study's LINK, its members and its session history while changing what vi
sitors actually reach. The alternative, unpublish and republish, mints a new link, which means re-sharing it with everyone.\n- [Se
ssion metrics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/session-metrics.md): Volumes, completion and feedback rates over the
study's sessions.\n- [Usage breakdown](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.md): Which models, tools and
servers the study's sessions used.\n- [Current window signals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/current-window-signal
s.md): What the miner extracted from the current window, and where you get the window id the insights read takes.\n- [List scenari
o findings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-scenario-findings.md): Every finding raised over this study's windo
ws, dismissed ones included: dismissal is a state on the finding, not a deletion.\n- [Read a window's insights](https://docs.mcpja
m.com/api-reference/studies/read-a-windows-insights.md): Poll this after requesting a generation.\n- [Request insights for the cur
rent window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-window.md): **No credits are consumed*
*: the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's current window and draws on the organization's `insightsPerDay` ledg
er, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, so a request here takes one from there.\n- [Cancel a
window's generation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/cancel-a-windows-generation.md): Releases a generation that is
stuck `pending`. Idempotent against an already-finished one.\n- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies
/dismiss-a-finding.md): Keyed on the finding's stable remediation id, so the same problem stays dismissed when insights regenerate
. Bodyless: the path names the finding.\n- [Restore a dismissed finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/restore-a-d
ismissed-finding.md): Undoes a dismissal. Bodyless: the path names the finding.\n- [Create (or revive) a relay tunnel for a named
project server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/create-or-revive-a-relay-tunnel-for-a-named-project-server.md): Regi
sters a server record named `name` if missing, mints a relay tunnel grant for it, and **persists the tunnel bearer URL (including
the plaintext `?k=` secret) onto the server record's `url`** so evals and studies can target the tunnel like any remote server. **
Every call rotates the secret, revok…\n- [Revoke a tunnel's live grant](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/revoke-a-tun
nels-live-grant.md): Revokes the grant: the public URL stops working immediately and any live tunnel session is disconnected. The
server record, including its now-dead `url`, is intentionally left untouched, so the next create revives the tunnel with the same
slug.\n- [Run one headless agent turn](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/agent/run-one-headless-agent-turn.md): Runs ONE assis
tant turn over the supplied message history and responds synchronously with the final assistant text, the operations it invoked, r
eferences to any resources it created, and any actions awaiting human approval.\n- [Connect an MCP server](https://docs.mcpjam.com
/api-reference/server-connections/connect-an-mcp-server.md): Starts a connection request for an MCP server URL. Discovery, browser
consent, and validation happen asynchronously; poll the returned `connectionRequestId` until the status is terminal. When the nex
t step belongs to a person, the response carries a `handoffUrl` to open.\n- [Get a connection request](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api
-reference/server-connections/get-a-connection-request.md): Current state of one connection request. Metered on its own poll budge
t rather than the shared per-caller one, so polling on a short interval is expected and will not spend the budget your other calls
need. A 429 here means the poll interval itself is too fast; honour Retry-After.\n- [Cancel a connection request](https://docs.mc
pjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/cancel-a-connection-request.md): Stops a request and invalidates its handoff link. Cance
lling an already-terminal request is a no-op.\n- [Retry validation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/retry
-validation.md): Re-arms a stalled validation immediately instead of waiting out its backoff. Does not revive a terminal request:
after `failed`, `expired`, or `cancelled`, start a new one.\n- [List personas](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-p
ersonas.md): The project's personas, newest first. Archived personas are excluded.\n- [Create a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/a
pi-reference/swarms/create-a-persona.md): Creates one persona. To draft several with a model first, use `POST /projects/{projectId
}/personas/generate`: that route persists nothing.\n- [Get a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-persona.m
d): A persona that lives in a DIFFERENT project answers 404, never 403: the route is not an existence oracle for a project you can
not see.\n- [Delete a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/delete-a-persona.md): Refused with 409 while goals sti
ll reference this persona: deleting it would strand them.\n- [Update a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/updat
e-a-persona.md): Partial update. Goals reference the persona by id, so renaming one does not disturb anything pointing at it.\n- [
Draft personas with a model](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/draft-personas-with-a-model.md): Returns DRAFTS and pers
ists nothing; save the ones you want with the create routes. There is no idempotency key, and retries return different drafts.\n-
[Draft journeys for a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/draft-journeys-for-a-persona.md): Returns DRAFTS and p
ersists nothing. See `POST /projects/{projectId}/personas/generate` for why, and for the quota this counts against.\n- [Get a jour
ney](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-journey.md)\n- [Archive a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/s
